CustomField.formula: IF(AND(Review_Result__c = 0, ISPICKVAL(State__c, 'COMPLETED')),IMAGE('/resource/'+$Setup.Credentials__c.Namespace__c+'icons/Competed.png', 'No issues', 22, 127),IF(ISPICKVAL(State__c, 'CANCELED') ,IMAGE('/resource/'+$Setup.Credentials__c.Namespace__c+'icons/ErrorY.png', 'Error', 22, 127),IF(AND(Review_Result__c > 0, ISPICKVAL(State__c, 'COMPLETED')),IMAGE('/resource/'+$Setup.Credentials__c.Namespace__c+'icons/IssuesY.png', 'Issues found', 22, 127),IF(OR (ISPICKVAL(State__c, 'WAIT REVIEW'), ISPICKVAL(State__c, 'IN PROGRESS')) ,IMAGE('/resource/'+$Setup.Credentials__c.Namespace__c+'icons/InProgress.png', 'In progress', 22, 127),''))))
CustomField.label: Result
